subject: [RFC PATCH 12/18] mm/filemap: don't defer the free of folios of an inode being evicted

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch prevents the deferral of free operations for folios of an inode being evicted by clearing the PG_rcu_free flag when the final truncate removes a folio, especially in cases where the file is still open and under memory pressure or at umount. This ensures that no lockless reader can be in the page cache of an inode being evicted. The patch modifies the Linux kernel's mm/filemap.c and include/linux/page-flags.h files to achieve this goal.
